commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Como are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
90+2' Jacobo Ramon (Como) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
90+1' The referee gives a yellow card to Manuel Akanji (Inter).
90+1' Jacobo Ramon (Como) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' 3 - 4 Goal! Lucas Da Cunha (Como) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yann Sommer into left side of the goal.
89' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
88' The referee blows his whistle as Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) was too aggressive in his challenge. No point in arguing there. Como will take a penalty kick.
87' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) has tested the patience of referee Davide Massa and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' Nico Paz (Como) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
86' The shots on goal statistics – 7:5.
83' Carlos Augusto (Inter) gets booked for the first time in this match.
81' Como are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
80' Alex Valle comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alberto Moreno (Como).
79' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
79' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Assane Diao is replaced by Alvaro Morata (Como).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolo Barella leaves the pitch and Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) comes on.
77' Petar Sucic (Inter) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
76' Martin Baturina (Como) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
74' Como hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
72' 2 - 4 Goal! Denzel Dumfries (Inter) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:4.
70' Nico Paz (Como) unleashes a shot goalwards from a mid-range free kick. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a decent save to thwart him.
69' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
67' It's time for a substitution. Ivan Smolcic (Como) comes on in place of Ignace Van der Brempt.
65' Como are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.

62' Marcus Thuram (Inter) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
60' Martin Baturina (Como) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
60' Great teamplay by Como as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

58' 2 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Hakan Calhanoglu flights the free kick into the box, where Denzel Dumfries (Inter) peels off his marker and heads straight into the left side of the net from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 2:3.
56' Here is a change. Piotr Zielinski is going off and Cristian Chivu gives the last tactical orders to Petar Sucic (Inter).
56' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Francesco Pio Esposito will be replaced by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter).
56' The referee signals a substitution. Luis Henrique (Inter) is brought on as a substitute for Federico Dimarco.
55' Assane Diao (Como) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Piotr Zielinski (Inter) was quite harsh and Davide Massa didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

52' The ball rebounds out to Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
52' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
51' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to the feet of Maximo Perrone (Como), who directs his low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is there to block the effort.
51' Como are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
49' 2 - 2 What a finish that is! Marcus Thuram (Inter) sees that Jean Butez is off his line and scores with a brilliant lob from the edge of the box. He makes it 2:2.
46' Substitution. Sergi Roberto makes way for Lucas Da Cunha (Como).
46' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jacobo Ramon (Como) replacing Diego Carlos.
46' Alessandro Bastoni goes off the pitch and Carlos Augusto (Inter) comes on.
46' The whistle blows and Davide Massa starts the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' 2 - 1 Spectacular goal! Marcus Thuram (Inter) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 2 - 0 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Nico Paz (Como) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
44' Martin Baturina (Como) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Yann Sommer.

43' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Nico Paz (Como), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
42' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Davide Massa saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to Como, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
40' Como have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Federico Dimarco (Inter) will take the corner.
39' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
38' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.

36' 1 - 0 The goalkeeper makes a save but the ball rebounds off him out to Alex Valle (Como). He finds himself some space inside the penalty area and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner, bouncing in off the post. A magnificent goal!
34' Davide Massa couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) and blew his whistle.
32' Alex Valle (Como) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
32' Assane Diao (Como) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
30' Neat passing move from Como in order to create new attacking opportunities.
29' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) commits a rough foul. Davide Massa stops the game and makes a call.
27' Nico Paz (Como) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
24' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Alex Valle (Como) for his blatant foul.
23' The percentage of ball possession is – 53:47.
21' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
19' Marcus Thuram (Inter) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
16' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Inter.
14' Assane Diao (Como) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
13' Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Davide Massa had a clear view and blows his whistle.
12' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
10' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
7' The Como players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Nice passing game by Como. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
4' Davide Massa blows his whistle and it's Anastasios Douvikas (Como) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
2' Manuel Akanji (Inter) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
